en: An illustrated postcard showing an elegant outdoor café or restaurant scene, with well-dressed people sitting at tables under large trees and a wooden pavilion labeled 'Etablissement Weitzer.' Inset in the upper right is a circular vignette of a grand church or basilica on a hill labeled 'Maria Trost.' The style is typical of late 19th or early 20th-century European postcards. There is handwriting in German on the bottom right portion of the card.
